expressions.bm_formal: Biar saya semak. / Saya akan semak.
expressions.bm_casual: Kejap, saya check. / Biar saya tengok.

expressions.bm_formal: Saya mohon maaf atas kesulitan ini.

work.scenario: Your team is rushing to finish a presentation for a client. You need a colleague to quickly review the slides.
key_phrases: Bolehkah anda semak slaid ini sekejap?
Mohon pengesahan jika ada apa-apa perubahan.
Terima kasih atas kerjasama anda untuk projek ini.

life.scenario: You're at a local 'kopitiam' (coffee shop) and want to confirm your order and ask for an extra spoon.
key_phrases: Boleh tak saya minta sudu lebih?
Tolong confirm order saya 'Kopi O Ais' ya?

tech.scenario: A friend calls you for help because their internet connection is not working. You're trying to guide them through basic troubleshooting steps.
key_phrases: Saya faham, cubalah restart modem dulu.
Sorrylah susahkan, tapi kena sabar sikit ya.
